other_intakes: September (Autumn semester); enrolment ~1-14 September, lectures the following week
application_deadline_for_spring_intake: NOT FOUND — the programme's Procedure & Calendar page published, at access date, only the autumn window: "Candidates wishing to start their studies in September 2026 (Autumn 2026 semester) should apply during the pre-enrolment period open from January 8th 2026 to July 1st 2026." evidence_verbatim: "We have two intakes: Autumn Semester (starting in September) [and] Spring Semester (starting in February)" — and "around February 1st-14th (lectures start around February 15th) for the Spring semester"
notes: GENUINE SPRING COHORT START, not a segundo periodo of the autumn cohort: the enrolment page separately dates enrolment AND the start of lectures for the spring semester, which an application round cannot do.
